findings.what: The red goal frame has missing or detached corner geometry, clipping abruptly at the edge of the frame.

findings.where: Center foreground, around the player figure
findings.what: The 'WON' target reticle and 'MATCH 1' title card heavily overlap and clutter the player character model and gameplay area during active sequence.

findings.where: Far boards, along the top perimeter
findings.what: Extreme overexposure/bloom along the top edge of the rink boards blowing out all edge detail into pure white.
The skater is completely missing their hockey stick while in a skating/faceoff stance.

findings.where: Upper center ice, near the far red line
findings.what: Only a single opposing player is visible in the distance with no other teammates or opponents rendered on the rink for a 3-on-3 match.

findings.where: Upper-left quadrant, along the glass panel
findings.what: An untextured or placeholder white rectangular prism mesh floats suspended above the boards.

findings.where: Center, around the blue player character
findings.what: Player stick is clipping invisibly or missing its shaft, rendering disconnected from hands.

findings.where: Bottom center, underneath the pause menu modal
findings.what: The bottom control hint text overlays directly across the ice lines without a dark backing plate, creating low contrast and visual clutter.
The goal structure appears identical to Still A, showing an unattached floating net frame cut off without proper base mounting.
